summary: Gix Internet Ltd., a dual-listed Israeli foreign private issuer (Nasdaq: GIXI; TASE: GIX), furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the launch of a new corporate website describing its AI-driven orchestration layer for hospital logistics via wholly owned subsidiary Deliverz.ai. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is stated. Disclosed operational metrics include continuous commercial use at Sheba Medical Center since December 2025, over 7,000 autonomous missions, chemotherapy delivery time cut from 40 to 14 minutes, and a public tender allowing up to 30 robots. No special-situation event; purely a corporate communications update.
